text.html:
Private label is the right path for businesses ready to invest in their own matcha identity.

But it's not the only option.If you want to offer a premium, market-ready matcha brand in your space, without the development time, minimum volumes, or branding investment of a private label programme, ASA Matcha is available exclusively to Pure Matcha Partners clients.

ASA Matcha — Brand-Ready, Available Now
‍ASA Matcha is a Dutch premium matcha brand built around the same Japanese-origin, certified organic matcha we supply in bulk. Designed for the European consumer market, stocked at De Bijenkorf and premium concept stores and cafés across Europe.

For Pure Matcha Partners clients, it means you can offer your customers a finished, branded premium matcha product — without building one yourself.

The range includes:
‍Ceremonial Matcha from Uji — stone-ground, first harvest
Hojicha — roasted Japanese green tea, low caffeine
ASA GO — the first no-whisk ceremonial matcha in Europe
Accessories & gift sets — whisk, bowl, scoop, curated starter kits

ASA Matcha is available exclusively to Pure Matcha Partners clients. No separate supplier relationship needed.

text.html: Do you offer private label matcha for new brands?

text.html: We specialize in private label supply for established or scaling brands, with a minimum order of 10 kg. If you're just starting out, we’re happy to advise, but we focus on long-term, scalable partnerships.
text.text: We specialize in private label supply for established or scaling brands, with a minimum order of 10 kg. If you're just starting out, we’re happy to advise, but we focus on long-term, scalable partnerships.
